competing_limits: Fit caps include all refits and each 20-fit arm has a fixed 1200-second training limit. Some jobs shared host CPU, so wall time cannot support a speed comparison. If a cold run exhausts time, retain and score the actual automatically exported checkpoint at the common deadline. Record its training-row count, full refit state and observed fits separately. A partial checkpoint cannot establish a full 20-fit baseline.
sensitivity: If the unexpanded control is partial, reconstruct its original controller's choices using exactly matching, already measured predictions whenever possible; train only missing outcomes, complete its selected full-data refit and reload. Each reused fit is one logical budget unit but contributes zero new physical fits. Count all new physical fits separately. This is a compute-matched counterfactual beyond the deadline and must be identified separately from the cold run. Freeze it before opening external labels.
